english.title: Obstruct an authorised person in the execution of his powers under section 109 of the Environment Act 1995
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally obstructed **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person authorised under section 108 of the Environment Act 1995 in the exercise or performance of

(A)_[his]_
(B)_[her]_

powers under section 109 of that Act
english.legislation: Contrary to section 110(1) and (4)(a) of the Environment Act 1995.

english.notes:
(i) Authorised person means a person authorised under section 108 and includes a person designated under paragraph 2 of Schedule 18 to the Environment Act 1995.
(ii) Powers and duties includes powers or duties exercisable by virtue of a warrant under Schedule 18 to the Environment Act 1995.
(iii) See alternative offence under section section 110(3D) and penalty under 110(3E) when the offence is committed against a person authorised by the Agency or the NRBW and the operation was in respect of water undertaker / sewerage undertaker or water supply licensee / sewerage licensee: H102064.
(iv) See section 110(5I) for offences committed by body corporate.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
